sources.snippet: Key TakeawaysWashington proposed tariffs of up to 15% on Taiwan, or up to 25% if talks fail. Taiwan's notice exempts chips, smartphones, PCs and servers, the core of TSMC's, Apple's and Qualcomm's businesses.
